name: briefing-video-chat
description: Create end-to-end encrypted Briefing video and chat rooms and put the invitation link into emails and calendar events. Rooms are made on your computer; the moderator link never goes to Claude.

instance.title: Briefing server
instance.description: Address of the Briefing instance, e.g. your own server. The official one is https://brie.fi/ng/.

share_links.title: Let Claude see the participant link
share_links.description: On: Claude can put the link into emails and calendar events. Off: links only go to your clipboard and your browser. The moderator link never goes to Claude.
